lede: The most substantive public business this week happens Monday, when the Open Space Commission takes up three Valley Floor items — including competing trail alignment options for Reach 1 and a Telluride Mountain Club request to route a quarter-mile of trail through open space. Then Thursday, the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code changes touching forestry, oil and gas, geothermal operations, and condominium plats — no final votes, but these are the sessions where the shape of decisions gets set.
